headline: A 222-pack metadata sweep: supportedModules lands on existing fetch-incidents params
summary_md:
- 222 packs move for 7 upstream commits (+10,921/-6,078). No pack was added or removed.
- Two of those commits are phases 1 and 2 of one `supportedModules` sweep over existing Fetch Incidents parameters (CIAC-17795) — the only change large enough to explain a pack count this high.
- The day is mostly metadata: 196 of the 222 packs delete 3 lines or fewer, and 179 change 30 lines or fewer in total.
- Two thirds of the 16,999 changed lines sit in seven packs whose insertions and deletions nearly cancel — **IronPort**, **Gem**, **DatadogCloudSIEM**, **DataBee**, **Sysdig**, **DigitalShadows** and **Orca**.
- The remaining five commits are product fixes: `xdr-xql-generic-query` arguments, Intune timestamp parsing, Netskope network-event mapping, and two KeyError fixes.

highlights.title: xdr-xql-generic-query gains source_id and source_name arguments
highlights.detail: CRTX-269392 (#45513); CortexXDR (+37/-25) and Core (+45/-25) both move by near-identical amounts, the signature of the paired XDR and XSIAM copies of one command.

highlights.title: supportedModules is updated on existing Fetch Incidents parameters in two phases
highlights.detail: CIAC-17795 lands as #45667 and #45670 on the same day; the snapshot does not name the packs each phase touched, but nothing else on the day could move 222 of them.

highlights.title: Seven packs are rewritten near line-for-line and gain almost nothing
highlights.detail: IronPort (+1,863/-1,850) leads; Gem, DatadogCloudSIEM, DataBee, Sysdig, DigitalShadows and Orca repeat the shape, together 66% of the day's churn for a net of a few dozen lines.

highlights.title: Netskope maps xdm.observer.action to action for network events
highlights.detail: XSUP-75725 (#45677) changes what the pack writes into the XDM observer field for network events; the pack moves +40/-5.

highlights.title: The Intune parsing rule stops requiring fractional seconds in timestamps
highlights.detail: XSUP-74549 (#45654); MicrosoftIntune moves +10/-3, consistent with a single parsing-rule edit.

highlights.title: Two KeyError fixes: Jira Service Management and HealthCheckCommonIndicators
highlights.detail: XSUP-75105 (#45582) and #45354 (#45676) land together; HealthCheck is the day's largest addition outside the rewritten packs at +149/-5.

items.Packs/CortexXDR: +37/-25. Carries CRTX-269392, adding source_id and source_name arguments to xdr-xql-generic-query.
items.Packs/Core: +45/-25. Moves with CortexXDR by a matching amount — the XSIAM-side copy of the same xdr-xql-generic-query change.
items.Packs/Netskope: +40/-5. XSUP-75725 maps xdm.observer.action to action for network events.
items.Packs/MicrosoftIntune: +10/-3. XSUP-74549 lets the parsing rule handle timestamps that carry no fractional seconds.
items.Packs/AtlassianJiraServiceManagement: +40/-2. XSUP-75105 fixes a KeyError in the integration.
items.Packs/HealthCheck: +149/-5. Fixes a KeyError in the HealthCheckCommonIndicators script, and the day's biggest addition outside the seven rewrites.
items.Packs/ApiModules: +142/-3. The second-largest near-pure addition of the day; no commit subject in the snapshot names it.
items.Packs/IronPort: +1,863/-1,850. The day's largest change and a near line-for-line rewrite — 22% of all churn for 13 net lines.
items.Packs/Gem: +1,039/-1,026. Rewritten on the same shape as IronPort, 13 lines to the good.
items.Packs/DatadogCloudSIEM: +946/-922. Third of the seven rewritten packs; insertions and deletions again nearly cancel.
items.Packs/Orca: +223/-198. The smallest of the seven near line-for-line rewrites.
